name: Krasnodar
registryBasis: The official city administration identifies the Municipal Information Center for Urban-Planning Activity (GISOGD) as the unit that maintains and provides Krasnodar GISOGD information and supports municipal cadastral-plan procedures. Official city documents contain cadastral-plan sheets and parcel maps, but the reviewed material is document/request based, not an anonymous vector feature service. The city’s official-publication amendment to the GISOGD service regulation and available municipal map documents did not yield a safe public polygon schema. No land/parcel identifier, owner, address, request form, or personal identity was submitted.
pointBasis: UN WUP 2025 population-weighted settlement centroid; this is not a municipal boundary or a parcel-coverage claim.
technicalBlocker: Official municipal material establishes GISOGD, cadastral-plan workflows, and document-based records but does not publish an anonymous feature endpoint/schema. No credentials, cadastral number, address, person, or property document request was submitted.
scopeLimits: Official public-page/document discovery only. No owner, address, tax, personal-identity, credential, account, title, cadastral-number, CPF, or property-specific lookup was submitted or retained. No full parcel geometry was retained. The supplied WUP point is not treated as a legal boundary.
remainingUncertainty: Whether the national public cadastral map or Krasnodar GISOGD exposes a safe anonymous full-polygon service that can be spatially bounded to the supplied WUP point; coverage and non-identifying fields are unknown.
nextStep: Find first-party map-service metadata and a safe field projection before feature queries; avoid cadastral-number/address-based lookups and property-record request forms.

officialSources.observation: The official Krasnodar City Administration identifies its municipal information center for urban-planning activity, which maintains the city GISOGD, provides documents/materials from that system, and handles cadastral-plan location schemes.
Official city document repository lists a Krasnodar cadastral-plan land-location scheme; this is a specific municipal document, not a general public parcel API.

Official Krasnodar municipal bulletin publishes amendments to the GISOGD information/materials service regulation. The published service is a request workflow; it does not expose a public safe parcel-layer schema.
The municipal administration has a Department of Municipal Property and City Lands, confirming the local land-management institutional remit.
